script_text: This week, the cosmos delivers a powerful Venus-Jupiter sextile that hasn't activated for Libra in years. Monday and Tuesday, the Sun in your 3rd House sextiles Pluto in Pisces, giving your words magnetic power in negotiations. But Wednesday brings friction as Mercury squares Saturn, threatening miscommunication around contracts. As an Air sign, Thursday's turning point hits when Venus enters Gemini and activates your 4th House of home and family, stirring deep emotional shifts. Friday through Sunday, Mars trines Venus from your 11th House, drawing supportive allies into your circle. Tuesday is your power day because the Sun trines Neptune in your 7th House of partnerships, bringing love into crystal clear focus. Wednesday is your toughest day because Mercury square Saturn creates career delays and contract confusion. One tip: lean into your Air sign diplomacy this week because one honest conversation could reshape your entire month. Follow for daily updates.
